input.quote: 11.1.1.4 Trial Data Package. SFJ shall be the sole and exclusive owner of the Trial Data Package including the Research Results included therein.
input.rationale: The Trial Data Package is defined as all Information generated by or on behalf of either Party in the conduct of the Clinical Trials, including the Clinical Trial Database and the Research Results (p0227), so Section 11.1.1.4 vests ownership of PB-generated trial data and work product in SFJ. PB recovers ownership only on payment of the Approval Payments plus a further purchase price, and the Article 14 assignment (p0783) is expressly effective only "in accordance with Section 11.1.1.4", so there is no present vesting in PB. PB also has no interim licence, and SFJ's ownership carries an unrestricted right to exploit that data: Section 11.1.1.6 limits only PB-Controlled IP that PB delivers or discloses to SFJ and does not reach the SFJ-owned Trial Data Package. The clause therefore fails the fallback on both the licence-back and the service-limited-use elements. Elsewhere Article 11 is favourable (mutual retention of pre-existing IP at p0650, PB ownership of Trial Inventions and Background Materials), so we propose the fallback cure rather than reversing ownership, which would require rewriting the purchase mechanic and its cross-references in Articles 6 and 14.

ops.text: In addition, SFJ hereby grants to PB a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license, with the right to sublicense through multiple tiers, to use and modify the Trial Data Package, including all Research Results, for PB's business. SFJ shall use the Trial Data Package, including all Research Results, solely to perform its obligations and exercise its rights expressly set out in this Agreement, and shall not disclose, license, transfer, sell or otherwise exploit the Trial Data Package for any other purpose.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] SFJ owns the Trial Data Package - all trial data generated by or for PB - until PB pays to buy it back, so PB has no right to use its own data and SFJ is free to exploit it. We have added our fallback position: a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence back to PB to use, modify and sublicense that data for its business, plus a restriction limiting SFJ's use of the data to performing this Agreement. SFJ's ownership, the Approval Payments and the Exhibit K purchase mechanic are untouched.
proposal.summary: Add a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence back to PB over the Trial Data Package and limit SFJ's use of that data to performing this Agreement.
